name: Member's Mark Hickory Smoked Pulled Pork (Deli Tub)
whyItWorks: Slow-smoked pork shoulder shredded into tender strands in sweet barbecue sauce. Pork is very soft and easy to chew, but sweet barbecue sauce and vinegar require moderate gut tolerance.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm gently in microwave or skillet. Serve on a plain white hamburger bun or over white rice. Avoid adding spicy hot sauces.
